# Paste artefacts for https://adscade.com/vsl-4/

Generated by `node tools/build-widget.mjs`. **Do not hand-edit these files** — edit
`site/index.html` and regenerate, or the next build silently discards your change.

| File | Where it goes |
|---|---|
| `home-widget.txt` | Elementor → HTML widget on the `/vsl-4/` page (full-width section, no container padding) |
| `head-tags.txt` | Theme header injection (Astra → Header/Footer Code, or a code-snippets plugin), `<head>` position |

`tools/integrity.mjs` validates these exact files, not its own copy of the transform.
